analysis-cost-profit-2.name: Building Material Cost & Profit Analysis
analysis-cost-profit-2.intro: Apply descriptive statistics to a series of material costs, prices or quantities — total, mean, median, range, variance and standard deviation — for supplier comparison, quote dispersion and budget volatility analysis.

brinell-hardness.name: Brinell Hardness Calculator
brinell-hardness.intro: Compute Brinell hardness BHN = 2F / [πD(D−√(D²−d²))] from test load F, indenter diameter D and indentation diameter d.

bulk-modulus.name: Bulk Modulus Calculator
bulk-modulus.intro: Compute bulk modulus K = E/[3(1−2ν)] from Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio, describing resistance to uniform compression.

bulk-modulus-e-nu.name: Bulk Modulus from E and ν Calculator
bulk-modulus-e-nu.intro: Compute bulk modulus K = E/[3(1−2ν)] from elastic modulus E and Poisson's ratio ν.

density-basic.name: Density Calculator
density-basic.intro: Compute density ρ = m/V from mass and volume, with support for common units in material selection and mix design.

detector-35.name: Cement & Concrete Quality Grading
detector-35.intro: Grade cement, concrete, fired brick and block samples against GB/T 175, GB/T 50081, GB/T 5101 and GB/T 11968 using compressive and flexural strength results.

detector-40.name: Coating Environmental Compliance Grader
detector-40.intro: Assess coating environmental grade against GB standards from inputs such as VOC, formaldehyde, benzene series and heavy metal content.

detector-strength-color-diff.name: Natural Stone Quality Grading
detector-strength-color-diff.intro: Grade natural stone against GB/T 9966 from colour difference ΔE, compressive strength, flexural strength, bulk density and water absorption.

elastic-energy-density.name: Elastic Strain Energy Density Calculator
elastic-energy-density.intro: Compute strain energy density u = σ²/(2E) from stress and elastic modulus for energy storage and fatigue analysis.

engineering-strain.name: Engineering Strain Calculator
engineering-strain.intro: Compute engineering strain ε = (L−L₀)/L₀ as the relative change of gauge length for tensile testing and deformation analysis.

fourier-conduction.name: Steady-State Heat Flow Calculator
fourier-conduction.intro: Compute steady-state heat flow q = k·A·ΔT/L from thermal conductivity, area, temperature difference and wall thickness for insulation and heat dissipation design.

fracture-toughness.name: Stress Intensity Factor Calculator
fracture-toughness.intro: Compute stress intensity factor K_IC = Y·σ·√(πa) from geometry factor, applied stress and crack half-length to assess fracture safety.

hooke-strain.name: Hooke's Law Strain Calculator
hooke-strain.intro: Compute axial strain ε = σ/E within the linear elastic range for estimating deformation under tension or compression.

lame-lambda.name: Lamé First Parameter Calculator
lame-lambda.intro: Compute Lamé's first parameter λ = Eν/[(1+ν)(1−2ν)] from elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio for constitutive analysis.

linear-thermal-expansion.name: Linear Thermal Expansion Calculator
linear-thermal-expansion.intro: Compute thermal elongation ΔL = α·L·ΔT from expansion coefficient, original length and temperature change for expansion joint and fit design.

mass-from-density.name: Mass from Density Calculator
mass-from-density.intro: Compute mass m = ρV from density and volume for material estimating, batching and engineering unit conversion.

modulus-resilience.name: Modulus of Resilience Calculator
modulus-resilience.intro: Compute resilience U_r = σ_y²/(2E) — energy absorbed per unit volume within the elastic range — for toughness assessment and cushioning design.

poisson-lateral.name: Poisson Lateral Strain Calculator
poisson-lateral.intro: Compute lateral strain ε_lat = −ν·ε_long from axial strain and Poisson's ratio, describing lateral contraction or expansion.

poisson-ratio-calc.name: Poisson's Ratio Calculator
poisson-ratio-calc.intro: Back-calculate Poisson's ratio ν = −ε_lat/ε_ax from measured lateral and axial strains.

rule-of-mixtures.name: Rule of Mixtures Calculator
rule-of-mixtures.intro: Estimate equivalent composite properties such as density and modulus as volume-fraction weighted averages of the constituents.

shear-modulus.name: Shear Modulus Calculator
shear-modulus.intro: Compute shear modulus G = E/[2(1+ν)] from Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio for material parameter conversion and structural analysis.

shear-strain.name: Shear Strain Calculator
shear-strain.intro: Compute shear strain γ = τ/G from shear stress and shear modulus for shear deformation and torsion analysis.

specific-heat-capacity.name: Heat Capacity Calculator
specific-heat-capacity.intro: Compute heat capacity C = m·c from mass and specific heat capacity for heat exchange design and calorimetry.

specific-weight.name: Specific Weight Calculator
specific-weight.intro: Compute specific weight γ = ρg from density and gravitational acceleration for gravity load estimation in geotechnical and structural work.

tensile-force-area.name: Tensile Load from Area Calculator
tensile-force-area.intro: Compute allowable tensile force F = σA from allowable stress and cross-sectional area for strength checking and connection design.

thermal-diffusivity.name: Thermal Diffusivity Calculator
thermal-diffusivity.intro: Compute thermal diffusivity α = k/(ρ·c) from conductivity, density and specific heat, describing how fast temperature changes propagate.

thermal-resistance.name: Thermal Resistance Calculator
thermal-resistance.intro: Compute thermal resistance R_th = L/(k·A) from thickness, conductivity and area for heat transfer analysis of multi-layer insulation.

true-strain.name: True Strain Calculator
true-strain.intro: Compute true strain ε_t = ln(L/L₀) using the natural logarithm for large deformations in metal forming and finite element analysis.

vickers-hardness.name: Vickers Hardness Calculator
vickers-hardness.intro: Compute Vickers hardness HV = 1.854·F/d² from indentation diagonal d and test force F (converted to kgf).

volumetric-strain.name: Volumetric Strain Calculator
volumetric-strain.intro: Compute volumetric strain ε_v = ε_x + ε_y + ε_z from three principal strains for elastic-plastic deformation and soil volume change analysis.

young-from-kg.name: Young's Modulus from K and G Calculator
young-from-kg.intro: Back-calculate Young's modulus E = 9KG/(3K+G) from bulk modulus K and shear modulus G.

youngs-modulus.name: Elastic Modulus Calculator
youngs-modulus.intro: Compute Young's modulus E = σ/ε as the ratio of stress to strain for tensile testing and stiffness evaluation.
